response.overview: A LEGO live-action adaptation of the cult classic The Rocky Horror Picture Show, brought to life brick by brick in a one-of-a-kind solo stage performance. Combining handcrafted miniature sets, custom minifigures, and live puppetry, this theatrical production reimagines Dr. Frank-N-Furter’s castle and iconic musical numbers with playful creativity and camp flair.
response.title: The Rocky Horror LEGO Show
